question: At compute matched to GPT-3 Large, what average zero-shot accuracy does the 2-stage H-Net reach compared with the BPE Transformer, and which larger Transformer does it match?
final_text: The authors report that the 2‑stage H‑Net configuration (#FLOPs matched to GPT‑3 Large) has an average zero‑shot accuracy of 55.5 % [HNET:T2:r10]. The authors report that the Transformer configuration (#FLOPs matched to GPT‑3 Large) has an average zero‑shot accuracy of 53.3 % [HNET:T2:r01]. The authors report that the Transformer configuration (#FLOPs matched to GPT‑3 XL) has an average zero‑shot accuracy of 55.5 % [HNET:T2:r11].
